designOrigin: Frozen independently before observing any Trial 28 economic output. Trial 27 showed static cross-venue carry economics can be strong but fixed venue collateral can breach isolated-margin and unilateral-gap gates. Pure calendar notional re-anchoring is unnecessarily costly by arithmetic, so Trial 29 tests a sparse risk-triggered de-leveraging rule instead: weekly collateral equalization plus notional re-anchoring only when market appreciation pushes either leg above a frozen 150% of current sleeve equity.
hypothesis: A static long-Binance/short-Hyperliquid BTC/ETH funding carry with 75% initial sleeve notional per leg can retain at least 7% annualized return after conservative costs while passing isolated maintenance and 20% unilateral-gap stress if collateral is equalized weekly and position size is only reset after a large notional/equity expansion.

finalHoldout.accessRule: Final market rows and economics may be observed only after every frozen development gate passes.

strategy.direction: always long Binance perpetual and short equal-coin Hyperliquid perpetual
strategy.riskOrdering: At each boundary book realized price/funding, test maintenance and 20% unilateral gap stress before any rescue action, then perform scheduled collateral equalization. If either leg notional exceeds 150% of current total sleeve equity after collateral equalization, close and reopen both legs at 75% of current sleeve equity with full modeled execution costs.

fundingClock.hyperliquid: Use raw Hyperliquid fundingHistory settlement/publication event time; sum records in (previous 8h boundary,current boundary], do not backdate or interpolate.
fundingClock.causality: Only actually settled funding cash is booked.

costModel.application: 15 bps per venue leg per open/close/re-anchor; 5 bps on gross collateral moved during weekly equalization.

marginModel.rule: Fail if either venue balance is below 5% maintenance or would be below maintenance after an instantaneous adverse 20% move before hedge offset. Stress is checked before scheduled transfers or notional reduction.

antiRescueRule: After the first Trial 29 development economic output, no scientific parameter, asset, notional, trigger, collateral target, transfer cadence, cost, clock rule, or gate may change under Trial 29.
